entities.summary: Santa Maria in Via is a church in Rome. The church or a chapel existed in the 9th century, but was rebuilt following reports of a miracle. In 1165, it is recorded as Santa Maria in Via, whose appellative means "on the Way", with a reference to the nearby Via Flaminia. Santa Maria in Via is a church building in Europe, established in 901 CE. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
